# MacXP

> A standalone, pixel-accurate recreation of Microsoft Windows XP (Luna Blue theme) built entirely in Swift and SwiftUI for macOS 13.0+ (Ventura, Sonoma, and Sequoia), featuring an authentic boot screen with animated blue cubes, window manager, start menu, taskbar, sound engine, Macromedia Flash Player with classic games, and a full suite of retro applications.

## Documentation

- [Project Overview & User Guide](README.md): Comprehensive documentation covering features, UI components, application suite, shortcuts, packaging, and architecture.
- [System Architecture & Design Specification](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-29-macxp-os-design.md): In-depth technical specification covering data models, window management, state synchronization, file system virtualization, and UI chrome design.
- [Component Implementation Plan](docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-29-macxp-os-plan.md): Step-by-step technical implementation breakdown for window chrome, desktop canvas, Explorer, and built-in apps.
- [Audio Engine & Screensavers Plan](docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-29-macxp-sounds-and-screensavers-plan.md): Technical details on audio asset playback, 44.1kHz sound synthesis fallback, and 3D Pipes / Starfield screensavers.
